clips.title: The story
paras: To Thunder Bluff marks the triumphant return of a young tauren druid from their communion with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade. Having earned the favor of the Great Cat Spirit, the initiate returns to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise to master the art of feline shapeshifting.

After proving their insight and worth before Dendrite Starblaze and the Great Cat Spirit in the sacred groves of Moonglade, a young druid must carry the spirit's blessings back to Mulgore. The communion with such primal powers represents a pivotal milestone in a druid's training, bridging ancient night elven teachings with the tauren's own earthen heritage.

Awaiting your return high atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff is Turak Runetotem. While Dendrite facilitated communion with the spirit itself, it falls to Turak to guide the physical transformation. With the blessing of the Great Cat Spirit acknowledged, the elder trainer imparts the sacred knowledge required to adopt the swift, predatory shape of the cat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back, friend. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.
I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
